messages:
anya: Quick thread to finalise the Optimize toolkit launch gating matrix. Need minimal set that Product + Eng can sign off on — keep it engineering-friendly and customer-aware.

tom: I'll keep bullets short. We need: perf SLOs, batch targets, cache hit targets, econ uplift threshold, quant-safety ceiling, eval-alert reliability, tenant staging rules.

izzy: Throwing a proposal: two-tier SLOs (fast paths and large-seq paths), batching min avg and tail queue limit, cache warmed hit rate, econ uplift median + 90th pct constraint, quant max regression, alert FP/FN caps.

clara: Also require per-tenant mode: OFF / Recommend-only / Auto-apply. Enterprise opt-in must include explicit consent + audit log.

rachel: Ops asks: include fallback behavior for incompatible quant builds and a clear auto-rollback window. Also require sample traces attached to alerts.

anya: Draft acceptance (pasteable):

```
Optimize toolkit pilot acceptance (concise):
- Performance: p95 <= 275ms for seq_len <512 (fast-path); p95 <= 425ms for seq_len >=512 (long-path). Measured on Dedicated pilot hardware under warmed cache conditions where applicable.
- Batching: average batch size >= 5 on batched routes during peak; batching queue tail p95 <= 18ms to avoid visible tail effects.
- Cache: warmed KV-cache hit rate >= 68% on cacheable flows during pilot windows.
- Economics: median per-token cost reduction >= 12% vs baseline on replayed anonymized traffic (>=10k prompts). Additionally, 90th-percentile cost must not increase for any major route.
- Quant safety: recommended quant variants must not cause >2.5% absolute drop on the primary quality metric across the core prompt set.
- Eval-triggered alerts: detection threshold = >6% relative drop over 1k evals or 24h (first). Target alert FP rate <= 6% and FN rate <= 10% on labeled regression sets. Alerts must include 3 representative trace samples and a severity tag.
- Tenant modes & audit: tenants must be able to set OFF / Recommend-only / Auto-apply. Auto-applied recs must produce an immutable audit entry and a one-click rollback in Console.
- Rollout & fallback: canary at 3% traffic, staged ramps with manual checks at 10% and 50%. Auto-rollback on sustained SLO breach >5 minutes. If recommended variant incompatible with runtime, auto-fallback to nearest compatible variant and emit a flagged metric/event.
- Observability: pilot telemetry retention = 14 days; ability to surface per-route cost/latency breakdown and 3 trace samples per alert.
```

izzy: I like these. One tweak: require live A/B econometric check for at least 4 hours in addition to replay to validate real-world queuing effects.

tom: add that econ pass must be conditional on no quality gate failures (i.e., econ improvements that cause quality regression fail the gate).

clara: For tenant UX: recommend-only should surface a preview diffs screen and CSA can enable auto-apply per-tenant. I'll draft the tiny flow.

rachel: I'll own rollout automation + fallback metrics, can have canary automation ready by Tue (1987720000). Also will add auto-rollback runbook.

anya: Owners and artifacts:
- izzy: eval-alert tuning + labeled regression set (deliver threshold proposals + test suite)
- tom: econ replay + live A/B harness (deliver scripts + anonymization doc)
- clara: tenant UX snippet + audit log spec
- rachel: rollout automation + fallback metric + runbook

ops-bot: Reminder: pilot cluster deploy window Fri 09:00 UTC.

izzy: timeline OK — hope to have eval set and initial thresholds by Thu EOD (1987670000).

tom: replay harness + live A/B plan by Thu noon (1987665000).

clara: UX snippet by Wed EOD (1987662000).

rachel: canary automation by Tue (1987720000) as noted.

anya: If owners hit these deliverables we plan to start the canary next week. If blockers appear, flag here and we'll re-scope. Short, concrete agreement. :white_check_mark:
